newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT -FTSE TO STRIDE UP TOWARDS 5,065.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT -FTSE TO STRIDE UP TOWARDS 5,065.

text.p: The FTSE 100 index will regain its poise and make strides towards 5,065 on Tuesday, technical analysts said.
The market's resolve not to dip below its 10-day moving average on Monday implies a firm foundation for the FTSE from which it can rebuild lost momentum, they added.
Buying attention should once again focus on banks, oils and possibly tobacco stocks but pharmaceuticals may dither.
There should also be relief that on Wall Street on Monday, the Dow managed to find a firm footing near the 8,000 level, which will allow it to embark on an upward march.
By 0730 GMT, the FTSE was up 25.8 to 5,057.7. On Monday, the Dow Jones Industrials closed up 30.89 points to 8,062.11.
The past three days has seen the FTSE in a daily average trading range of 80 points as anxious investors took profits. With confidence returning, such volatility should be reduced, analysts said.

But the ratio of advancing stocks to those declining may not improve much from Monday's five-to-four reading as attention could now be more geared towards smaller capitalised stocks such as those in Mid-250 index.
